Decipher.com Premiere card image for [[Gold 1]] (Wayback). It has the black border of Premiere Limited but prints the game text of [[Gold 1 (Unlimited)|Premiere Unlimited]] (April 1996), which added “Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.”; the printed Limited face is [[:File:Premiere-L-gold1-hires.webp]].

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020804005247/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/images/gold1.gif Decipher.com card image] (Wayback copy of decipher.com/starwars/cardlists).

Do not replace the Holotable/remaster face [[File:Premiere-L-gold1.gif]].
